message.content:
**Uno – Basic Rules** | Item | Description | |------|-------------| | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue). Each color has numbers 0‑9 (two of each except one 0) and two of each action card: Skip, Reverse, Draw Two. Additionally, there are 4 Wild cards and 4 Wild Draw Four cards. | | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or a pre‑agreed total). Points are earned by the cards left in opponents’ hands when you finish a round. | | **Setup** | • Shuffle the deck.
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining cards face‑down as the draw pile.
• Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. If it’s an action card, apply its effect immediately. | | **Gameplay** | Players take turns clockwise. On a turn, a player may play **one** card that matches either the color, number, or symbol of the top discard card. If they cannot play, they must draw one card from the draw pile. If that card can be played, they may play it immediately; otherwise, the turn ends. | | **Action Cards** | • **Skip** – Next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – Reverses the direction of play. (In a 2‑player game, it acts like a Skip.)
• **Draw Two** – Next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Wild** – Player chooses the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – Player chooses the new color; next player draws four cards and loses their turn. (Can only be played if the player has no matching color cards; otherwise, the opponent can challenge.) | | **Calling “UNO”** | When a player has only one card left, they must say “UNO” before the next player takes their turn. If another player catches them not saying “UNO,” the offender must draw two cards as a penalty. | | **Winning a Round** | A round ends when a player discards their last card. That player scores points equal to the sum of the values of all cards remaining in opponents’ hands: number cards = face value, action cards = 20 points, Wild cards = 50 points. | | **Winning the Game** | The first player to reach the target score (commonly 500) wins the game. | **Optional Variations** - **Stacking**: Allow players to stack Draw Two or Wild Draw Four cards on top of each other, forcing the next player to draw the cumulative total unless they can counter with the same type of card. - **Custom Rules**: Many groups add house rules such as “No Wild Draw Four on the first turn” or “Play a card that matches the number of cards in your hand.” Enjoy playing Uno!
